_help: SOURCE OF TRUTH for statusline prices. USD per 1M tokens, used for the per-agent $ estimate.
After editing, run: ./install.sh --prices  (copies this file to ~/.claude/statusline-prices.json).
'match' is a substring of the model id (e.g. claude-opus-5-5). The first match wins,
so keep specific ids (opus-5-5) above generic ones (opus).
'default' names the 'match' of the entry to use when no entry matches.
cache_write / cache_read are optional: they default to 1.25x and 0.10x of input.
